# ConfirmDialog


## Props (ConfirmDialogProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` * | `boolean` | Open state (alertdialog, modal). |
| `title` * | `string` | Question naming the object: "Delete “Peak time Friday”?" |
| `text` * | `ReactNode` | Consequence and who it affects; say what is kept. |
| `facts` | `string[]` | Extra facts as a short list ("The 18 tracks stay in the library."). |
| `confirmLabel` * | `string` | Danger button label, verb + object: "Delete set". |
| `onConfirm` * | `() => void` | Called by the danger button. |
| `onCancel` * | `() => void` | Called by Cancel and Esc. Cancel has initial focus. |
| `requireTyping` | `string` | High-stakes: the exact text the person must type (usually the set name) before the danger button enables. |
